items.title: Driver GPS drops in low signal areas
items.body: Location updates stop in Dharavi and Govandi. Root cause not found. Rebooting the phone restores it.

comments_data.body: Could be Android battery optimisation. Not confirmed.

items.title: Move hosting to Fly.io
items.body: Moves the API from the old VPS to Fly.io because the VPS provider is shutting down in April.

comments_data.body: Blocked: the inventory API changed its response format. New target is 15 Mar.

items.title: Driver onboarding needs a consent form
items.body: The legal team must approve the consent text before onboarding can ship. Contact: Advocate Meher Bano (meher.bano@foodlink.example).
